claims.claim: Donald Trump said a Friday call with Vladimir Putin produced an agreement for Russia to supply diesel to the American and global market.
claims.episode_span: President Donald Trump said a Friday phone call with President Vladimir Putin produced an agreement for Russia to sell diesel into the American and global market.
claims.source_title: Ukraine War, Day 1,689: Trump — Putin Is Selling Diesel Fuel to US
claims.supporting_quote: After a phone call with Putin on Friday, Trump posted: I have just concluded a highly successful discussion with President Vladimir Putin, of Russia, wherein it was agreed that Russia will immediately supply over 300,000 Tons of Diesel Fuel to the American and Global Marketplace, another 500,000 Tons during the month of November, and 1,000,000 Tons immediately thereafter.

claims.claim: The Guardian reported the diesel agreement put Trump on a collision course with Zelenskyy and European allies and upended years of pressure on the Kremlin over a four-and-a-half-year war.
claims.episode_span: The Guardian reported that the move put him on a collision course with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and European allies, upending years of pressure on the Kremlin over a war now in its fourth and a half year.
claims.source_title: Zelenskyy furious as Trump announces deal to buy Russian diesel
claims.supporting_quote: Donald Trump was on a fresh collision course with the Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, and European allies after a stunning agreement to buy Russian diesel, upending years of US and western pressure on the Kremlin to end its four-and-a-half year war against Ukraine.

claims.claim: Trump posted that Russia would supply over 300,000 tons of diesel immediately, 500,000 tons in November, and 1,000,000 tons immediately thereafter.
claims.episode_span: Trump posted that Russia would immediately supply over 300,000 tons, another 500,000 tons during November, and 1,000,000 tons immediately thereafter, EA WorldView reported.
claims.source_title: Ukraine War, Day 1,689: Trump — Putin Is Selling Diesel Fuel to US
claims.supporting_quote: Russia will immediately supply over 300,000 Tons of Diesel Fuel to the American and Global Marketplace, another 500,000 Tons during the month of November, and 1,000,000 Tons immediately thereafter.

claims.claim: EA WorldView said Trump's concern was rising diesel prices from the Iran war and Tehran's control of the Strait of Hormuz ahead of US midterms.
claims.episode_span: That outlet said he linked the step to rising diesel prices from what it called his war on Iran and from Tehran's control of the Strait of Hormuz, just before November's US midterm elections.
claims.source_title: Ukraine War, Day 1,689: Trump — Putin Is Selling Diesel Fuel to US
claims.supporting_quote: Trump tipped off his concern: rising diesel prices caused by his War on Iran and Tehran’s control of the Strait of Hormuz, just before November’s mid-term elections.

claims.claim: Zelenskyy called the diesel deal absolutely terrible and not fair and not honest.
claims.episode_span: Zelenskyy called the deal "absolutely terrible" and "not fair and not honest."
claims.source_title: Zelenskyy furious as Trump announces deal to buy Russian diesel
claims.supporting_quote: Zelenskyy reacted furiously to Trump’s announcement of the deal with Vladimir Putin , calling it “absolutely terrible” and “not fair and not honest”.

claims.claim: A US official with direct knowledge said Trump pursued the diesel deal because Zelenskyy ignored six requests to stop attacking Russian oil refineries.
claims.episode_span: A US official with direct knowledge, cited by EA WorldView, said Trump sought the diesel because Zelenskyy ignored six requests to stop striking Russian oil refineries.
claims.source_title: Ukraine War, Day 1,689: Trump — Putin Is Selling Diesel Fuel to US
claims.supporting_quote: A “US official with direct knowledge” says Donald Trump pursued a diesel fuel deal with Vladimir Putin because Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelensky ignored six requests to stop attacking Russian oil refineries.

claims.claim: A Ukrainian official said Witkoff and Kushner threatened to cut US intelligence sharing during eight hours of talks in Miami, and a US official denied the threat.
claims.episode_span: A Ukrainian official said that in eight hours of talks in Miami, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner threatened to cut off US intelligence sharing if the requests kept being ignored. That US official denied the threat.
claims.source_title: Ukraine War, Day 1,689: Trump — Putin Is Selling Diesel Fuel to US
claims.supporting_quote: A Ukrainian official said that, during eight hours of talks in Miami, Trump’s envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner threatened a cutoff of US intelligence sharing if Zelensky continued to ignore the requests. The US official denied the threat was made.

claims.claim: The BBC reported a Russian glide-bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia killed at least 15 people.
claims.episode_span: The BBC said a Russian glide-bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia killed at least 15 people.
claims.source_title: Ukraine war: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 15 people
claims.supporting_quote: Ukraine war: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 15 people

claims.claim: EA WorldView reported eight civilians killed, including three children, and 10 injured in Zaporizhzhia, with 14 people unaccounted for, and separately four killed and four injured in a residential-building strike.
claims.episode_span: EA WorldView later reported eight civilians killed, including three children, and 10 injured in an overnight strike on residential areas, with 14 people unaccounted for, and separately four civilians killed and four injured when guided aerial bombs struck a five-storey block
claims.source_title: Ukraine War, Day 1,689: Trump — Putin Is Selling Diesel Fuel to US
claims.supporting_quote: The toll has risen to eight civilians murdered, including three children, and 10 injured from Russia’s overnight strike on residential areas in Zaporizhzhia city in southern Ukraine. The fate of 14 people is unknown.

claims.claim: Euronews reported Russia plunged Kyiv into darkness on Thursday and that Zelenskyy called the strikes terror against people and life.
claims.episode_span: Euronews reported strikes in recent days on railways, bridges, power stations, schools and other civilian sites, and said that on Thursday Russia plunged Kyiv into darkness. Zelenskyy called it "terror against people and life."
claims.source_title: As Russia escalates, EU realises its Ukraine support won't be enough
claims.supporting_quote: On Thursday, Russia plunged Kyiv into darkness, offering a grim preview of a winter that is likely to be the harshest, cruellest yet of the war.

claims.claim: Ursula von der Leyen said the strikes are war crimes.
claims.episode_span: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said, "Pure and simple: these are war crimes."
claims.source_title: As Russia escalates, EU realises its Ukraine support won't be enough
claims.supporting_quote: "Pure and simple: these are war crimes," European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said, expressing her solidarity.

claims.claim: EA WorldView reported Ukrainian drones set a fire at the Yug Rusi terminal in Rostov-on-Don and damaged a Yandex data centre in the Kaluga region.
claims.episode_span: Drones reportedly set a large fire at the Yug Rusi oil-loading terminal in Rostov-on-Don, which handles export petroleum products, including from the Novoshakhtinsk refinery.
claims.source_title: Ukraine War, Day 1,689: Trump — Putin Is Selling Diesel Fuel to US
claims.supporting_quote: Ukraine’s drones reportedly set a large fire at an oil-loading terminal in Rostov-on-Don in western Russia overnight.

claims.claim: An unnamed European diplomat told Euronews the war will last longer than thought and that further needs lack a clear plan.
claims.episode_span: One, unnamed, said, "This war will last longer than we thought," and that further needs have no clear answer yet.
claims.source_title: As Russia escalates, EU realises its Ukraine support won't be enough
claims.supporting_quote: "This war will last longer than we thought," a European diplomat said, speaking on condition of anonymity. "There's a realisation that needs will continue to present themselves, but it's not yet clear how this will be addressed."

claims.claim: EU leaders agreed a 90 billion euro loan last year to cover two-thirds of Ukraine's needs for 2026 and 2027, on the premise the war would end this year.
claims.episode_span: The €90 billion loan leaders agreed last year was built to cover two-thirds of Ukraine's needs for 2026 and 2027, on the premise the war would end sometime this year.
claims.source_title: As Russia escalates, EU realises its Ukraine support won't be enough
claims.supporting_quote: The deterioration raises serious questions about the viability and durability of the EU's multiple support programmes, notably the €90 billion loan that leaders agreed last year to cover two-thirds of Ukraine's needs for 2026 and 2027.

claims.claim: Euronews reported a Russian Black Sea blockade is preventing Ukrainian farmers from selling grain.
claims.episode_span: A Russian blockade in the Black Sea is keeping farmers from selling grain and cutting a core source of state revenue, Euronews reported.
claims.source_title: As Russia escalates, EU realises its Ukraine support won't be enough
claims.supporting_quote: Russia's blockade in the Black Sea has added further strain, preventing Ukrainian farmers from selling tonnes of grain to their global clients and depriving the state of an essential source of revenue.
